snippet_primary: "Since 2017, I have run a small Etsy shop from Jordan, completing over 5,900 orders and fully complying with Etsy's rules. I was notified that (my Etsy shop will be forcibly closed on 5 August 2025), due to Etsy's decision to remove PayPal as a payment option and the absence of Etsy Payments in Jordan - leaving me no means to receive payments."
